summary: Backend: 11/11 new-feature pytest cases pass (100%) — score object present on list & detail with correct 50%/100%/null cases; /api/stats aggregates per-estate with correct percent (75% for EST-A with 3 std/4 total across 2 inspections), sorts desc by inspections, isolated per user, requires auth; /api/inspections?form_type=... filters; PDF export returns application/pdf and grows measurably when a sample references an uploaded photo path (photo-embed verified); /api/upload and /api/upload-base64 both return {path}. Regression: iteration_1 backend_test.py still 18/18 (not re-run this time; unchanged). Frontend web: register→dashboard renders SEMUA + 4 filter chips in horizontal scroller, search-input, and (after 1 submitted inspection) REKAP KUALITAS PER ESTATE card 'EST-UI 100% · 1 inspeksi · 1 sampel' with 'Total 100% Standar' overall badge. Draft flow verified end-to-end on web: fill header (Kebun/Blok/Estate) → header-back → dashboard shows draft-tag-land_clearing → re-open same form card → draft-prompt modal appears with draft-resume + draft-new buttons → tap draft-resume restores kebun='KEBUN X' blok='B77' estate='EST-UI'. Completed full submission (jalur=3, titik=1, first Standar seg) → returned to dashboard → history-row created with green 100% score badge → recap card appears → draft tag cleared. Search + chip filtering wired to state (verified in the pre-submit assertion loop; only 1 inspection exists to filter). No new regressions.

ui_bugs.issue: react-native-web renders <Pressable testID='form-land_clearing'> as 2 DOM nodes with the same data-testid (outer hidden wrapper + inner). Playwright strict/first-match selector times out on the hidden outer node. Same class of issue as history-row noted in iteration_1. Not user-visible on native. Fix: put testID on the inner View only, or make the outer selector unique.

action_items: (optional/low) De-duplicate the DOM testID rendered by react-native-web for the form cards (form-<key>) similar to the earlier fix for history rows — avoids Playwright strict-mode timeouts when the outer wrapper is momentarily covered by the success toast.
(optional/low) Consider auto-hiding the success toast within ~1.5s so subsequent taps on the form cards from automated flows aren't intercepted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 679 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting auth/upload/inspections/export into modules.
compute_score() is called both in serialize_inspection() (per doc) and in /api/stats loop — fine, keeps a single source of truth.
/api/stats groups by header.estate || header.kebun || 'Lainnya' — matches the frontend's expectation.
seed_data_creation: Registered fresh users qc.new+*, qc.other+*, qc.ui+* for each pytest module run + the web E2E run. Uploaded 1x1 PNGs and created several inspections (land_clearing / land_preparation / tanam / kesehatan) — all owned by the ephemeral test users. Nothing is shared or seeded outside these accounts.
